features.title: Image dataset ingestion, quality measurement and catalog review
acceptance: Ingest images in memory and calculate blur, exposure, and contrast metrics without storing raw files.
Persist quality records in SQLite with duplicate hash detection and batch isolation.
Provide paginated review table with sorting and filtering by batch and decision.

features.title: Failure signature grouping and metric clustering
acceptance: Group images by identical failure check signatures.
Cluster standardized metric vectors using deterministic k-means with dominant failure identification.

features.title: Human label policy calibration and synthetic benchmark suite
acceptance: Fit suggested quality policy thresholds from human good/bad feedback labels.
Evaluate training-set confusion matrix, precision, recall, and F1 score.
Generate synthetic benchmark scenes and evaluate quality detection accuracy.

features.title: Aggregate-only advisory explanations with multi-provider LLM support
acceptance: Generate aggregate-only quality explanations without sending image bytes or identifiers.
Support OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama provider endpoints with local offline fallback.

features.title: Decision CSV export with spreadsheet formula neutralization
acceptance: Export batch quality decisions and measurements to CSV format.
Neutralize spreadsheet formula injection by prefixing special characters.

features.title: OIDC Keycloak authentication with PKCE, session management and demo mode
acceptance: Provide OIDC authorization-code flow with PKCE and session cookie management.
Enforce CSRF token protection on mutating requests and role-based permissions.
Offer local development demo mode that is refused in production environments.

features.title: Dataset quality distribution percentiles and health profiling
acceptance: Compute statistical percentiles (p10, p25, p50, p75, p90) and dispersion for all image quality metrics.
Calculate batch pass/review/reject breakdown and human label agreement rate.
Expose GET /api/analysis/distribution endpoint and display quality distribution cards in the Analysis tab.

features.title: Comparative batch quality drift and Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistical tests
acceptance: Compare two dataset batches or time windows to detect distribution drift in blur, exposure, or contrast.
Compute two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-values for quality distributions.

features.title: Automated webhook notifications for high rejection rate batches
acceptance: Dispatch signed HMAC webhooks when batch quality rejection rate exceeds configured thresholds.
Allow operators to configure quarantine thresholds per dataset category.
